le_binding_flow.summary: LE aggregate codec resolves SDW rx/tx phandles, binds child components, then wires device links and uses TX regmap as CSR interface.

le_sdw_probe_flow.summary: LE SDW probe determines tx/rx role from port-mapping DT property, sets SDW port properties, and initializes regmap for tx role only.

regmap_initialization.summary: LE regmap is created via devm_regmap_init_sdw with 32-bit register addressing and MAPLE cache.

register_defaults_representation.summary: LE keeps register defaults as a static reg_default table in SDW file, coupled with readable/writeable/volatile callbacks.

cache_only_and_cache_sync.summary: LE starts tx regmap in cache-only mode pre-enumeration, then uses common attach callback and runtime resume/suspend to sync cache transitions.

enumeration_assumptions.summary: LE waits for tx SDW initialization completion before codec component probe proceeds; timeout is treated as error.

paging_assessment.summary: No explicit paging configuration is visible in LE WCD938x driver path.
findings: No use of paging_support or SDW page fields in wcd938x.c/wcd938x-sdw.c.
Register range appears below 0x10000 for WCD938x (base 0x3000 and max register macro in header).

la_vs_le_regmap_delta.summary: LA regmap uses 16-bit register addressing and RBTREE cache, while LE uses 32-bit register addressing and MAPLE cache.

safe_reuse_for_wcd9378.item: Aggregate codec + SDW child component bind/unbind pattern
DT port mapping split by tx/rx SDW child

wcd9378_fail_closed_items.item: Final SDW numeric identity for WCD9378
wcd9378_fail_closed_items.reason: WCD938x SDW tuple (0x0217, 0x10d, 0) does not prove WCD9378 tuple.

wcd9378_fail_closed_items.item: Paged register behavior for WCD9378 high-address ranges
wcd9378_fail_closed_items.reason: WCD938x code path does not demonstrate paged-register requirements.
Static LE structure cannot prove playback/capture correctness for WCD9378.

explicit_answers.does_wcd938x_teach_anything_useful_about: PARTIAL_ONLY. It teaches the LE matching model (use sdw_device_id and SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY) but not WCD9378 numeric IDs.
LIMITED. It shows regmap+cache lifecycle patterns, but does not prove WCD9378 paging requirements.
what_cannot_be_inferred_from_wcd938x: Whether WCD9378 requires paging_support=true at runtime
Whether controller-level SoundWire changes are required for WCD9378
